note: San Juan NF (Pagosa RD) campground near the end of FR 640, 2.3 mi north of Teal Campground above Williams Creek Reservoir: from Pagosa Springs ~15.5 mi on Piedra Rd, ~6 mi on FR 631, then 4 mi on FR 640. Mix of sunny and shady sites beside a meadow, a short walk to Cimarrona Creek; adjacent Cimarrona Trailhead. No dispersed camping within 300 yards. Generators limited to an hour at a time. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 10165225: confirmed 21 sites, 35-ft max RV, vault toilets, potable water, FCFS only, $28 (2027 same). Added season note with the 2026 late-season extension to Nov 15 (no water/trash). '~27 mi NW of Pagosa Springs' replaced by the FS directions; note cleaned of field restatements.
flags: Missing phone: Pagosa Ranger District (970) 264-2268 (FS page Office Contact). recreation.gov gives the concessionaire's (661) 702-1420.

Status: OPEN now under the 2026 late-season extension through November 15 with no water or trash (FS Current Conditions). FR 640 'Williams Creek' is Open on both segments on the San Juan NF road table as of 2026-10-27, after the Oct 22-25 floods. Note: Lower Piedra Road and Campground are closed indefinitely; the FS directions use 'Piedra Road' to FR 631. That road table lists Lower Piedra only, but the access road is worth confirming before a trip.

Waterfront check (stored not waterfront): on imagery Cimarrona Creek meanders through the meadow SE of the campground, ~100-150 m from the nearest pads (07, 09, 10) across open meadow. No creekside value is possible. The FS page itself quotes a visitor: 'Can see the reservoir from sites, but it's a good walk'. Williams Creek Reservoir is south, outside the 0.73 km frame. Possible lakeview re-audit lead (sightline from the southern pads 01/02/05 over the meadow); no change made.
Pin 37.53872,-107.20997 is 18 m from the centroid of the 21 catalogued site points; it is inside the loop between sites 06 and 07. OK.
